blockers: Authoritative GPU clock-policy readback and verified actuation/restoration are unavailable.
Driver telemetry timestamps are not qualified for live feedback.
CUDA device-event timing requires independent qualification.
Physical energy measurement is unqualified; energy savings are unavailable.
Fixed-clock allocation, frequency-only, live joint-control and joint static-sweep baselines have not been evaluated.

evaluation.baseline: matched optimized GPU-only under unchanged automatic clocks
evaluation.primary_scope: contiguous first release to last completion plus final gather; final independent validation excluded and command time retained

limitations: Automatic GPU clocks; fixed hardware capacity is not established.
No thermal isolation or exclusive host scheduling is established.
Generated inputs are not the original paper datasets.
Workload timing excludes final validation; full command timing includes it.
Tuning selects a static partition on separate inputs; no learned model is trained.
Positive, negative and inconclusive outcomes are retained.

package_energy.reason: Only Linux powercap interfaces checked; absence is not a claim about Windows sensors

next_requirements: independently qualified energy domain before savings claims

scope: allocation-only hardware evaluation and frequency shadow/simulation
statistical_scope: Pointwise exploratory 95% paired bootstrap intervals; 2000 fixed-seed resamples; no multiple-comparison adjustment.
